name: Boots of Striding and Springing

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Jump
powers.text: Cast Jump on yourself at will.

summary: Your Speed is at least 30 ft and isn't lowered by armor or weight; you jump three times as far.
text: These boots raise your Speed to 30 feet if it's lower, and neither loads beyond your carrying capacity nor Heavy armor slow you down. You can also cast Jump from them at will, but only on yourself.
